caption: The drawing depicts a geometric patchwork quilt design composed of repeating hexagonal shapes. Each hexagon is divided into three rhombus-shaped sections, creating a three-dimensional cube-like effect. The hexagons are arranged in a grid, separated by red triangular shapes that form a secondary diamond pattern throughout the composition. The interior sections of the hexagons feature various colors and patterns, including solid blue, different shades of brown, white with black stripes, beige, and a variety of small floral or dotted designs in colors such as pink, green, red, yellow, and purple. The edge of the quilt is bordered with a continuous red band, and the entire composition is centered on a plain off-white background. The overall effect displays a combination of solid and patterned sections, with the dominant colors being red, blue, brown, and various muted pastels.
title: Patchwork Quilt - "Evening Star"
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
